senses.gloss:
पर्प् पर्प् (a doubtful rt.; by some re-
garded as a Sautra rt.; cf. Uṇādi-s. IV. 81),
cl. 1. P. पर्पति, &c., to go or move.

पर्पट, अस्, m. a species of medicinal plant with
bitter leaves (= भेषजान्तर, तिक्ता क्षेत्र-पर्-
पटी, apparently the Oldenlandia Biflora); a kind of
thin cake, = चर्पटी; (ई), f. a kind of fragrant
earth or a red aluminous earth (apparently a sort of
Bol, brought from Surāt or Su-rāṣṭra); a sort of
fragrant substance or perfume (= कृष्णा, चक्र-
वर्तिनी, जतुका, commonly called पपरी); a thin
crisp cake made of any pulse.
—पर्पट-द्रुम
or पर्पटी-द्रुम, अस्, m. bdellium.

पर्पटक, अस्, m. a species of medicinal plant
with bitter leaves, (probably) Oldenlandia Biflora.

पर्पिक, अस्, ई, m. f. a cripple who moves about
by the aid of a chair.
पर्परी पर्परी, f. a braid of hair.

पर्परीक पर्परीक, अस्, m. (said to be fr.
rt. पॄ with reduplication), the sun; fire; a tank,
reservoir, piece of water.

पार्पर पार्पर, अस्, m. a handful of rice;
consumption (= क्षय-रोग); a filament of the
Nauclea Cadamba; ashes; = कीनाश; = गदान्तर
(a kind of disease ?); a N. of Yama.
